evidence.irr: 『established companies expanding their production and marketing of technical athletic apparel, as well as against smaller retailers』→認証/規格ロックなし・D2Cアパレルは代替容易=50
evidence.rep: 『Our competitors may be able to achieve and maintain brand awareness and market share more quickly and effectively than we can』→ブランドは数年で追随可=35
evidence.dur: 『which would cause our gross margin to suffer and could impair the strength and exclusivity of our brand』→堀の実体はブランド(規制/NW/スイッチングでない)=55
evidence.erosion: 『Competition may result in pricing pressures, reduced profit margins or lost market share, or a failure to grow or maintain our market share』+『pricing pressure from consumers』+Americas(売上71%)net revenue change (1.0)%→競争激化・値下げ圧・核市場減速=active

evidence.expiry: コンセッション/特許束等の期限型独占に該当するヒットなし。ブランド型=no
evidence.moatdecay: 『In 2025, the net revenue we generated in the Americas represented 71% of our total net revenue... Net revenue change (1.0)%』(核市場マイナス成長)+競争激化+opm 23.7→19.9%低下→核市場でブランド堀の逓減が進行=yes(保S候補フラグ)
evidence.geopol: 『Our concentration of fabric sourcing in Taiwan exposes us to geopolitical risks, including the possibility of military conflict, trade restrictions, or di…』(製品調達Taiwan集中)+『China Mainland represented 16% of our total net revenue』+関税/transshipment条項→2(重)
